policy.sourcePolicy: Prefer exact human Arabic pronunciation recordings for standard Arabic/Fuṣḥā learning. License, speaker/source, exact lexical item and source page must be documented. Source metadata that only says Arabic must not be relabeled as explicitly MSA without evidence.
policy.note: System-TTS und ungeprüfte KI-Stimmen sind als arabische Lernreferenz verboten. Externe Clips müssen Quelle, Sprecher, Lizenz und Originalseite dokumentieren.
qaRequirements: Arabic pronunciation suitable for standard Arabic/Fuṣḥā learning
Exact lexical item or unambiguous Arabic letter entity
policy.externalSourceRule: verified=true only for individually identified human Arabic recordings with documented free license, exact lexical/letter target, source page, and speaker/author. CC BY-SA sources must remain unmodified external originals.
policy.generatedPromotionRule: Locally generated clips remain blocked unless separately human-reviewed; external human reference audio is preferred for alphabet learning.
policy.shareAlikeRule: CC BY-SA audio may be used only as an unmodified external original file with attribution and license link. Do not normalize, trim, remix, transcode into a project-owned derivative, or publish a modified copy unless the resulting audio is distributed under the same or compatible ShareAlike terms.
